title: Article 259 — Armed Forces in States in Part B of the First Schedule (Omitted)

content.overview: Article 259 dealt with armed forces in States in Part B of the First Schedule. It was omitted by the Constitution (Seventh Amendment) Act, 1956, section 29 and Schedule (w.e.f. 1 November 1956) when the Part B classification was abolished.
content.glance: Art 259 omitted by 7th Amendment 1956 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956). Part B States classification ended.
content.study:
Article 259 was tied to the pre-reorganisation Part B States category.

Omission: Constitution (Seventh Amendment) Act, 1956, s. 29 and Schedule (w.e.f. 1-11-1956).

Examination rule: Do not cite Article 259 as living law.

sections.heading: Constitutional status
sections.body: Omitted by the 7th Amendment, 1956 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956) with the end of Part B States.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What is the status of Article 259?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Article 259 was omitted by the Constitution (Seventh Amendment) Act, 1956 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956). It is not living law.

examTips: Link to States reorganisation and end of Part B States.
